Available today

Technology inside TRADE

Only features that exist in the current application are listed here.

What you can use now

  • Market charts and volatility selection
  • Strategy configuration and signal workflows
  • Manual BUY/SELL and AutoTrader paths
  • Contract types including barrier-based options
  • Trade history, tracking, and risk controls
  • Copy-trading related controls where configured

How to think about tools

Tools organize information and execution. They do not remove uncertainty. A signal is not a guarantee; confirmation and risk limits still matter.

Use TRADE after you understand the educational topics that match how you want to operate.

Direction

The vision goes beyond trading

ZONA aims to connect knowledge, psychology, digital tools, and future opportunities. Trading stays central — it is not the entire story.

Honest roadmap framing

Planned / in development (not shipped as separate products yet): deeper education modules, expanded psychology resources, and additional digital tools. Until something is live in the app, treat it as direction — not a current feature.

Educational notice. Synthetic trading involves risk and you can lose money. Articles and examples on this site are for education only. They are not personalised financial advice and do not guarantee results. Only trade with funds you can afford to lose.

▼ 🎮 ZONA VIRTUAL OUTCOME FILTER DISABLED
Virtual trades use real market movement — no real contracts are purchased, no balance is touched
Filter Control
ENABLE VIRTUAL FILTER
Gate real auto-trades behind virtual outcomes
INDEPENDENT VOLATILITY QUALIFICATION
When enabled, every volatility index must independently satisfy the configured virtual-outcome requirements before its signals can use real funds.
CONSECUTIVE OUTCOME MODE
ON: require uninterrupted consecutive outcomes for BUY/SELL criteria. An opposite-direction outcome resets only an incomplete streak — never an already-earned qualification. OFF: existing interval-based counting.
CONTINUE REAL TRADING UNTIL WIN
After the virtual-loss threshold triggers a real trade, keep taking eligible real trades until a confirmed real WIN, then return to virtual monitoring. Real losses do not restart the virtual count.
COMBINED BUY & SELL LOSS COUNT
When ON, consecutive verified virtual losses from BUY and SELL share one counter toward the loss threshold (e.g. 3 BUY + 1 SELL = 4). A virtual WIN still breaks an incomplete sequence.
NEXT SIGNAL MUST MATCH QUALIFIED SIDE
When ON, a side that completes its virtual-loss requirement may take a real trade only if the next eligible signal is on that same side. An opposite-side signal invalidates the pending qualification.
